Load and validate the frozen PAGe v3 weekF12 model bundle

Source: R/v3_runtime.R
page_v3_models.Rd

Load and validate the frozen PAGe v3 weekF12 model bundle

Usage

page_v3_models()

Value

Named list containing M0-A, M1-A, M2-A, M1-B and M2-B artifacts, plus `release_id`, `manifest`, and `manifest_sha256` metadata.
